title: Server selection live directory, Quick Join, and PD indicator drift
summary: ServerSelection now uses gameplay-server-published v2 live snapshots for Development servers. Rows carry server-owned player count, PD active/type/color, lock state, stable ids, TTL/stale heartbeat policy, and reserved empty publicPlayers for future public server data. Live two-account validation is still required.
ownerReport: Friend opened a server through Quick Join.
Owner did not see the server in ServerSelection.
Owner pressed Quick Join and joined the friend server anyway.
After the friend left and checked main menu, the server still did not show.
F9 reported server count 0.
2026-06-28 follow-up screenshots showed server raw=0 and client UI zero-row warning spam.
2026-06-28 follow-up: server rows appeared, but PD active state/icon did not show to another MainMenu client.
2026-06-28 follow-up: Quick Join users opened separate servers instead of joining the visible existing server.
2026-06-28 follow-up: server display ids do not need an SRV prefix; code blocks are enough.
2026-06-29 owner follow-up: live multi-place/multi-client validation is blocked for about two days because the game cannot be published; only Studio testing is currently possible.

2026-07-01 follow-up: PD active icon still did not show in server list and rows disappeared after about one minute; root cause was Development servers not running ServerSelection and relying on a short MainMenu pending launch seed.
requiredOutcome: Visible server rows and Quick Join must use the same trusted live directory source.
Directory diagnostics must show publish/read/filter/UI row counts without spamming every poll.
Active destination servers must publish heartbeat data quickly enough to appear in main menu.
Quick Join must join an existing available live server row and only create a fallback server when no row exists.
PD active/type state must be published as server-scoped row data and tint the authored PD icon by type.
Server display ids should be compact code strings without an SRV prefix.
Development gameplay servers must run ServerSelection and publish their own live snapshot row instead of depending on MainMenu placeholder data.
Server rows must be extensible for future server-owned public player data through a sanitized publicPlayers field.

title: Character creation preview rig moves or flings during appearance changes
summary: Owner Studio test currently shows no CharacterCreation preview issue. The resolved issue remains tracked because testers may still find edge cases around height, head attachment, hair alignment, rotation, and body-type draft switching.
ownerReport: Changing character creation values can move or fling the preview character.
Anchoring fixes caused floating or ground clipping during height changes.
Height should visually grow from the top while feet remain planted.
Non-height appearance changes should not reload or disturb the preview position.
2026-06-28 follow-up: rotating the preview can still fling the character; after one fling, changing hair or any appearance value keeps moving it.
2026-06-28 follow-up: preview no longer flings, but height changes stretch body parts without making the character grow upward.
2026-06-29 follow-up: whole-model height scaling shrank the full character instead of affecting only height.
2026-06-29 follow-up: head height should not change while dragging height, and saved-character hair could load under the head until rotation refreshed attachment alignment.
2026-06-29 owner follow-up: current Studio CharacterCreation test did not show problems, but keep the issue tracked because testers often find edge cases later.
requiredOutcome: Preview rig keeps a fixed feet-grounded pivot across appearance changes.
Height scale grows/shrinks from the ground line upward.
Hair, eye, face, color, rotation, and accessory changes do not re-pivot or fling the preview.
Height changes must use R15 BodyHeightScale behavior, with non-root parts free during rig rebuild and feet re-grounded afterward.
Height adjustment should affect vertical height only, preserving width/depth.
Masculine and feminine preview choices should be randomized once and then restored from each body type cache when switching.
Head size should stay at the baseline/default size while height changes, without detaching from the torso.
Hair/accessories should align to the current head attachment immediately after loading saved-character preview or switching height/body type.

title: Character creation needs two independent hair slots and color schema review
summary: Dual hair is primaryHairStyle plus optional secondaryHairStyle. secondaryHairStyle defaults to empty, and both slots share one hairColor and one hairDarkness value. Current single hairStyle path needs schema-aware expansion.
ownerReport: Character creation needs dual hair selection.
Dual hair means two independent hair slots.
Hair and eye colors should be reselected/reworked.
Head/face/hair preview changes should not visibly shift or reload the character.
Both hair slots should share the same hair color and darkness.
secondaryHairStyle may be empty and should default to empty.
requiredOutcome: Creation draft and saved appearance payload support primaryHairStyle plus optional secondaryHairStyle.
secondaryHairStyle defaults to empty and can remain empty.
Both hair style slots share one hairColor and one hairDarkness value.
Legacy single-hair saved payloads remain valid or migrate safely into primaryHairStyle.
Server validation and client options use explicit mappings for both hair style slots.
Preview and spawn application attach, tint, cleanup, and reapply both hair accessories deterministically, while skipping empty secondaryHairStyle.
Eye color options are reviewed with explicit client/server ids.

title: ODMGear Titan slash damage and hook target registration issue
summary: Resolved: ODMGear Titan slash hints now reach the registered MindlessTitanSystem API. Player/dummy behavior and the unified 360-degree query remain unchanged.
ownerReport: ODMGear slashes deal damage to players and dummies, but deal no damage to Titans.
Issue was noticed after blade sheath/unsheath and animation changes were introduced.
Testing with frozen Titans and Studio debug mode confirmed slash hints/contact do not register against Titan nape.
Hooks thrown at Titans can attach to invisible combat hitboxes (GrabVolume, NapeHitbox) instead of physical mesh body.
requiredOutcome: ODMGear slashes must deal damage to Titans using the unified chest-centered 360-degree spin query without changing hitbox size.
Client contact query and server validation must correctly identify Titan nape and eye zones when slash query intersects Titan model.
Hook raycasting must exclude combat hitboxes and attach cleanly to Titan physical mesh or world geometry.
attemptedSolutions: 1. Line-of-sight raycast filter adjustment: Excluded workspace Runtime and Titan models from raycast filter in TitanCombat. (Reverted per owner directive).
2. Quick-tap slash intent sequence threshold removal: Modified ODMGearService.handleSlashIntent to accept fast slash sequences. (Reverted per owner directive).
3. Hook flight position tracking: Updated ODMGearMovementController._updateFeedback to track moving Titan targets during flight. (Reverted per owner directive).
4. Attribute typo fix: Checked ODMGearConfig vs UpgradeConfig attribute names for hasGear.

5. Contact target zone mapping: Updated ODMGearInputController getContactTarget to resolve Nape/Eye zones when query hits Titan parts, and excluded GrabVolume/hitboxes from hook raycasts in ODMGearMovementController.
resolution: Root cause was not blade sheath/unsheath or the replacement slash animations. ODMGearService.handleSlashContactHint still requested the removed runtime feature id TitanSystem after the feature had been renamed and registered as MindlessTitanSystem.

Updated the Titan slash runtime lookup to MindlessTitanSystem, allowing the existing reportValidatedSlash boundary to run again without changing query size, zone validation, damage authority, or networking.
Project Lead Hak confirmed Titan slash damage works in Development Play on 2026-08-01. Temporary diagnostic logs and runtime test Titans were removed.
